title: Test: pinned staff sessions and a step that is refused on purpose
story: An engine test, not one of the bench's scenarios: four real staff sessions at fixed times (one in the head start, one through web-01, one from a second address), with the bench profile.

notes: Engine test of pinned staff sessions and the key help desk. No step contacts a company host.
